column1: Mimicking

Our only conclusion is that we're getting there, America, because the American people have put their faith and confidence in us. Believe me. We are going to continue to make America great and greater than ever before. And we have been doing a fantastic job. It's truly incredible when I look at what has been accomplished. The strength of our economy is unparalleled, and we are so proud of it. Our country is respected again.

But as the President suggested, when we unveil the guidelines that the team has been working on, hopefully, the American people will be very, very happy. We are going to do a great job. We love the American people. Very, very much. And the American people are going to be very, very happy. And whether it is the vaccines or the other things, nobody has ever done what we've done.

So--no, we were always going to get it. We never had a problem with it. We got the masks; we got the gowns. We're ready. In fact, we're just about ready. We got the ventilators, too, but nobody wants them. With the help of the Army Corps of Engineers, we're going to be building hospitals all over the country.

All I'm saying is this: How do you close down the greatest economy in the world? And we're going to be doing certain things. We're doing certain things right now. We want to do it in a very scientific manner. We're going to be looking at the scientists. We're also looking at the doctors. We have some great doctors, the best in the world. Many things have gone wrong during this period, and many things have gone right. It's a disgrace what's happened.

When we think of more than 619,000 Americans having tested positive, more than 45,000 having died, and the fact that we're going to be doing tremendous testing over the next few weeks, it's going to be very interesting. Testing, testing, testing. A lot of testing is taking place, and it's very important. Everybody's talking about testing. It's very, very crucial.

The next second time that I went with Dr. Birx in--to the President and said, and I said, "I think this is very serious. We have a problem." And she agreed. Then, shortly thereafter, we made a decision. A very important decision. We wanted to protect the American people. We have to protect the American people. We have no choice. It’s all about protecting the incredible people of our country.

And after that, I said, "Oh, make sure that's in the bill." It was amazing And we did it. We got it in the bill. And then when they went to get a vote, they couldn't believe it. I said, "Put it in the bill." And then some people say, "Well, why'd you do that?" Because it was a great deal, and a great deal is what we want. You know it.

But the big thing, never quit, never give up; do something you love. When you are passionate about what you're doing, it's not work. Success follows. We're going to keep fighting, keep working, and never, ever, give up on America. Thank you very much, and God bless you.

If you're Democrat, you have automatic protection. That's years and years of people putting in a lot of time and money. And now it's been revealed that the whole thing was a hoax. It was a setup and they have a lot of very bad, sick people involved. And it was a very sad thing to watch. People are very angry, and rightly so. But we will get to the bottom of it. We will get to the bottom of it very quickly. Because we have to.

In the last three years, ICE has arrested over 5,000 wicked human traffickers. And I appointed a tremendous man, a great man, to lead our border patrol, and that's what we're doing. We're getting the bad ones out. The really bad ones. And we are bringing back very many people. We're being very nice, and we're letting people come in, and they're coming in at numbers that nobody's ever seen before.

We've removed unnecessary restraints on our warfighters in Afghanistan. Those who risk their life and limb deserve the full support of the United States. I gave them that support, and I'm very proud of it. We want to make sure that our great warriors are able to win. We want to go back. We want our warriors to come home. They're doing a great job. But now we are ready to go back.

We have a chance now to pass into law the immigration reforms that the American people have been demanding for decades and that many of you have been working on for your entire careers. We have a great opportunity as a Republican Party, and we have a great opportunity. We're getting very little help from the Democrats. But we will get it done, whether they want to or not. We will get it done, and we will make sure it's good for the United States.

And I've been able to talk to many of those states. And I just remind them that the relationship is good, but if they don't treat us fairly, they're going to have a problem. And we're looking very strongly, and we're bringing these companies back. We're bringing them back. They're going to come back to the United States. It's going to be great.

From the instant I took office, I moved rapidly to revive the U. S. economy--slashing a record number of job-killing regulations, enacting historic and record-setting tax cuts, and fighting for fair and reciprocal trade agreements. We are doing very well. Tremendous numbers. The best ever. Nobody’s seen numbers like this. And, frankly, the fake news won’t report it. But, that’s okay. Because we know it. And the people know it. And that's all that matters. Thank you very much.

You know, the truth is that we have coronavirus cases now in 46 American states. And we're working with the governors very, very closely. We’re doing everything to prevent the spread. We’re coordinating with the states to implement aggressive measures to safeguard Americans’ health and well-being. We have the greatest people in the world.

I want to speak now directly to America's children, especially those who feel lost, alone, and afraid. I want you to know that you are loved and that you are special. You are talented, and you are brilliant. You are smart, and you can be whatever you want to be. And we want you to have the very best. We're going to have a lot of things. We are going to make it so great for you.

The last two lines are aerosols. What does it do in the air? We have a lot of different answers, and some doctors and some scientists don't agree. But, eventually, it goes away. I get along very well with doctors, I like doctors very much, great people, and I'm very friendly with them, and they say it goes away. They want to get rid of the virus. We will, and we will get rid of the virus very quickly.

These encouraging developments have put us in a very strong position to finalize guidelines for reopening. We’re doing it very professionally and very carefully, in concert with all of the states. We're working very, very hard. We want to get it done as soon as possible. We're also working with all of the governors, and we're going to get it done right. And it's going to be very, very successful, I think. I think very, very successful. We’re doing it.

Very importantly, we entered into historic cooperation agreements with the governments of Mexico, Honduras, El Salvador, and Guatemala, which will have tremendous impact. Tremendous impact. We put tremendous pressure on those governments, and they're really helping us. We have a lot of great help. But we were not being helped anywhere near as much as we should have been to stop the flow of people and of drugs. And, frankly, even the flow of bad people. A lot of very bad people. And they were not helping us much.

That's page 1,689; page 1,762. Think of it: 1,762. And that's nowhere near the end And we've done thousands of pages, and it's all about the same thing. So we had the greatest Economy, ever, and then we built it again. And now we’re doing it again. We're rebuilding it, and we’re doing it with the greatest people, the greatest minds, the greatest everything.

But does anybody really believe the numbers of some of these countries that you've been talking about? They're probably faking it. You look at some of these countries, and you wonder. We're doing tremendously. We built the greatest economy in the history of the world. And then, unfortunately, we had to close it down. But now, we're building it again. We're building it bigger and better than ever before. The stock market is already at an all-time high.

And you'll see some data when Admiral Polowczyk gets up in just a few moments, and you'll see some of the data that he's got, and it's really something. We have the best military in the world, and we're going to keep it that way. I want people to get the vaccine, and I encourage you to get it.

To the citizens of our country, serving as your president has been the honor of a lifetime. Together, we have witnessed miraculous achievements, faced down formidable challenges, and built the most prosperous and inclusive society in the history of the world. We have pushed to new heights and new horizons. The best is yet to come. We will hold onto our values, protect our citizens, and always, always make America great. Thank you very much.

And, as you know, Europe was just designated as the hotspot right now, and we have a big problem. We have a very, very big problem. We're working very hard in conjunction with Europe. We're doing very well with Italy. And Spain, and many, many other countries. And we are learning. And we're doing a great job. We are helping them a lot, and they are helping us.

A small number of social media platforms are acquiring immense power over what we can see, hear, and ultimately, think. This poses a grave threat to freedom of speech and fair discourse. We've seen the power of these platforms to censor, shadowban, and even deplatform conservatives. It’s a very unfair situation. We have to do something about it, and we will. We will be fair to everybody, and we're going to win. We're going to win big, and frankly, we're going to win easily. It’s going to be very easily.

And whether it's Kate Steinle or so many others, they'd be around today if these people were not allowed to come into our country. They would be around, and it's very sad. We have to know what we're doing. The Democrats don't want to know. They want the open borders. You know what that means? It means crime, and it means danger. It means tremendous danger.

But, for now, the best advice that we can give for people is to speak to your doctor. Speak to your doctors. Find out what's going on. I'm very proud of the job that we've done. I think we've done a fantastic job for the country. And we're getting better and better, frankly. I mean, every day, we're getting better. We have a lot of very, very talented people, and they're working very hard.

As long as you remain loyal, faithful, and true, then our enemies don't even stand a chance. I’m not the one who gets them. With the exception of one deal, a very, very big deal, a beautiful deal, there was no deal. I want to thank everybody. I will be back.

The NIH, CDC, and FDA are also currently validating several antibody tests that will allow us to monitor the spread of the virus, and I think that's very important. And we're working very closely with states and governors and some of the best people. They want to see what happens, but it's a very good thing. And the governors are great people, and we're very happy to have them.

Good afternoon everybody. My name is Bill Bryan and I lead the Science and Technology Directorate at the Department of Homeland Security. As you know, we've been working very hard on this, and the work has been outstanding. We have teams of people that are doing incredible things. I would like to review the results from our studies, and then answer your questions.

No, they say worse; they say negative. They say negative. They're going to make the United States, if I don't win, and they say the country will be a disaster. They're wrong. We're going to win, and we're going to make our country greater than ever before. I just think it's a very sad thing to hear.

Likewise, we are restoring our nation's manufacturing might, even though predictions were, as you all know, that we wouldn't have any manufacturing left. We are bringing back jobs. As you know, they were leaving in droves. We are also defending religious freedom. In November, we had the highest number of jobs created. Tremendous. The best in the history.

At the same time, we know that mortality and the fatalities that we're facing across -- they are in a stage that we're able to do something about it. We've learned a lot about this invisible enemy. Every American has a role to play. With this invisible enemy, we're attacking it from every possible angle, and we will prevail. We will prevail.

So when I got $700 billion, and then $716 billion -- and this year, it's almost $750 billion. It's a lot of money. What's happening is we're making a lot of great equipment and, frankly, the best in the world. We're making equipment and we are building equipment, and we're letting people buy it. They're buying it. And we're the biggest in the world right now by far.

Today, I am proudly announcing six brand-new initiatives to propel this new era of American greatness. They will be focused on families. They will be focused on workers. They will be focused on business, and, of course, on this country, the United States. We have the greatest country on Earth. We have a great country. We're going to do great things. And we're going to do them fast. Because we have no other choice. We have to do it, we have to do it right. And we will be doing it tomorrow.

And what you're seeing now with this order is that we're going to be able to get medicines much cheaper. They're going to be much, much cheaper, and it's going to be great. And they're going to be, frankly, great. So what we're going to do is negotiate massive discounts on prescription drugs, and they're going to be giving us the best prices, and they’re going to be big.

The ongoing tragedy in Syria is heartbreaking. Our shared goals must be the de-escalation of violence, the defeat of ISIS, and the creation of conditions that prevent the resurgence of terror. We are supporting those who are working to achieve those goals. We want something to happen, and fast. It has to happen, and it will happen. We're doing a very, very good job, and we’re going to take care of it.

Together with millions of hardworking patriots across this land, we built the greatest political movement in history. I was attacked -- horribly attacked -- by people that I hardly knew. We did the best economy in the history of our country twice. We built the greatest economy ever. And now we’re doing it again.

It's been a horrible time to see such death and destruction, especially when you come from the area--and these are good people. And in the last 24 hours, we’ve been talking to numerous governors, and we’re working very, very hard. And we’re working with, as you know, FEMA, great organization. We love FEMA. FEMA’s fantastic, what they do. And we’re going to get this done, and we’re going to get it done right.

It was that same yearning for freedom that nearly 250 years ago gave birth to a bold and revolutionary American experiment. We had tremendous success. We've done an amazing job. We established a nation where citizens of all races, religions, and creeds could live in peace and prosperity. It's a beautiful thing. These are historic times. These are great times. Thank you very much.

Through four long years, you have honed your skills, trained your mind and body, overcome countless battles. Nobody thought you could do it, but you did. And now, you stand on the precipice of a new era. An era of unprecedented opportunity. An era of victory that can and will change everything. Together, we will make America greater than ever before. Thank you very much.

I was in Vietnam, and the Prime Minister and the President of Vietnam were there. And they want to do trade deals. They really do. And we'll see whether or not we can make those deals work. But they're very tough negotiators, and so are we. And we love our country. So hopefully, we'll get a good deal.

So I can only tell you what I know and what my recommendations were. But, but you've got to understand, it wasn't a simple thing. It was very complex. Complex and difficult, and what we did was something very, very special. And we did it together. We're very proud of that, and a lot of people are very happy.

Jobs and companies are coming back to our country like never before. The power of American workers is being unleashed. And we've been doing this for a long time, and the numbers are really, really tremendous. The people are great, and they love our country, maybe more than they've ever loved it before. We are making America great again!

And I don't think--I don't know who gave the orders to stop in Vietnam. But I have a news conference coming up, and they are going to ask me questions about it. But the worst of it all is I believe in the United States. I'm going to keep fighting for you. The people who are watching this have the same feeling. We are going to work together.

Interestingly, we were just talking, I was talking to Doug, and the numbers they're doing and they're just incredible. We've had some of the best economic numbers ever, and the best numbers in many, many decades. And it's been a great situation. And we're going to continue to do many good things. We're going to continue to do the best.

But let me just tell you--wait. And what they're doing, because they think it is I don't know. We're going to find out. I got to know, like, so many people. You know, so many are actually now doing very well. It's, in my opinion, incredible. Then the stock market, think about it.

I want to thank Deborah Birx, and I want to ask her maybe to come up here. Deborah, please. I've gotten to know her very well. She's a tremendous person. And I know you. And she has been working so hard. We're going to be talking about some really important things. And maybe you could just say a few words. You've been a star.

Last year, 70,000 Americans were killed, at least -- I think the number is ridiculously low -- by drug overdoses. And the number goes up every year. We have to stop it. And we're stopping it. We're working very hard. We're working very, very hard. We're doing things that nobody has ever done before, and the results are incredible. We've made a lot of progress. But we have to continue to work. We're going to stop it.

A safe and phased reopening of our economy--it's very exciting, but it does not mean that we are letting down our guard. We must remain vigilant and continue to protect our nation and the incredible people of our country. We're going to get it done. We will get it done. We have to get it done, and we will get it done.

Evelyn, Elizabeth, Freddy, and Robert: Tonight, everyone in this chamber is praying for you. Everyone is praying for their families, and for the families of all those who are suffering. We will never forget the lost souls. We will never forget the heroes. And we will never, ever give up. We will not. It's going to be a long, hard road, but we will prevail.

I have to say that, very excitingly, we're going to have somebody up; Bill will be here momentarily. And he's going to have a lot of people working with him on this project. It's going to be a very, very important project -- a project of great importance. Hopefully, we're going to get it done very quickly. Everyone says we've done things very quickly. It's true.

She saw it very early on, and we have -- I don't know if we did it. She said right from the beginning, "This is a scam." And I said, "What do you mean?"  And she said, "This is a scam." And other people said, "You know, maybe it's not what you think." They were wrong.

With every action, my administration is restoring the rule of law and reasserting the culture , and reasserting the culture of liberty in our nation. We are standing up for the forgotten men and women of America. We are restoring power back to the American people, because that's what it's all about. We are making America great again. And we are doing it rapidly. We've done a fantastic job.

But a tremendous thing was done over the last number of months, but really, if you think, years. We have rebuilt our military. We had a military that was depleted. We have the greatest weapons in the world. We've spent $2.5 trillion over the last few years, and now, we have the best equipment anywhere in the world. We make the best equipment. And frankly, we've done a great job.

Well, I don't know that I had exposure, but I don't have any of the symptoms. And we have the greatest doctors in the world. We have the best doctors anywhere. They've told me -- and I've taken a test, and it's going to be announced very soon. I think it's going to be announced, maybe tomorrow. We're going to see.

The Iranian government masks a corrupt dictatorship behind the false guise of a democracy. It It imprisons its own people. It murders its own people. They don't want to talk about it. They don't want to discuss it. Look, Iran has been a problem for a long time. And frankly, it is a problem now. And it will continue to be a problem.

I'm the one that find them. I'm the one that settled it. Over a billion dollars. And President Xi called me. He wanted to make a deal. And we made a terrific deal. It was a great deal. And by the way, we are respected again. We are respected again. We are going to make America great again.

The core rights and values America defends today were inscribed in America's founding documents. Our country was founded on the proposition that all people are created equal, endowed by our Creator with certain inalienable rights, and among these are life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness. We’re very, very proud of it. We’re very, very proud. We cherish liberty, and we believe in the dignity of every human life.

We'll continue our historic regulatory reduction campaign. We've--as you know, in three and a half years, we've cut more regulations than any administration in the history of our country, and we've done it at a level that's hard to even believe. We have a lot of progress, a lot of things, a lot of big things happening, but we're not finished, not even close. We are going to continue to make America great again.

Iain has always dreamed of going to space. He was the first in his class to launch a paper rocket beyond the school. We have the greatest people in the world, and they want to do great things. And we're going to take them. We're going to win. We won't accept anything less.

As just one example, I recently met the CEO of a terrific American company, Micron They’re doing fantastically well. And again, it was one of the largest investments in American history. We’re bringing back manufacturing plants. We’re doing things that people thought couldn’t be done. We’re making them now, and we’re making them fast.

But this is an unprecedented time. But I have to tell you: When you look at what's happening, they're great numbers. We had probably the greatest economy in the history of the world. And then something happened. And now we're going to rebuild it. We're going to start the rebuilding. And it's the greatest rebuilding in history. And it's happening right now.

But I took this action early. And so the story in the New York Times And fake news is wrong. We got it done early. But the New York Times refuses to write the truth. In fact, they actually were very wrong, and they still don't get it. It's fake. They're failing -- and failing badly.

Thank you very much. So I asked Bill a question that probably some of you have been asking, and maybe should be asking. And that is, what is happening with the stock market, because this is a very interesting situation. And I said to Bill, maybe it's a great problem. So, you know, we’re down, but we’re also up, and then we’re down, and then we’re up. Right? And he said, “Well, it's okay, and it's going to get better.”

We see it in sons and daughters who cheer on moms and dads as they face unimaginable challenges. But they do it and do it well. I'm very proud of the job they're doing. And frankly, it’s really been something. We’re going to make that important for this country. It’s very important. America will move far ahead with our current efforts.

So we called some people, wished them a very happy Labor Day, and they told me, "Sir, you're doing an amazing job." And they said, "Oh, they are so happy with what's happening." And we think the work is going to be very good, and we think you're going to be very happy. And then we're going to have a great, great economy, maybe the best we've ever had. And that's what we're doing. That's what we're doing. And we're doing it very, very quickly. And we're doing it right now.

In Philadelphia, observers have been kept far away -- very far away -- so far -- as to prevent any chance of infection. And that's what it is, you know? It's infection. And it is a sickness, you understand? We'll get through it. We will get through it. We're going to get through it together.

In just over 2 years since the election, we have launched an unprecedented economic boom--a boom the likes of which our country has never seen before. It just doesn't happen. It just doesn't happen. We achieved the lowest female unemployment numbers in 65 years, and the lowest African American and Hispanic American unemployment numbers ever recorded. These are incredible numbers.

The American people will be encouraged to know that, as we stand here today, 24 years ago, there was a man who was not being treated fairly. And I know, in the middle of it, the doctors looked at me, and they said, “Sir, you’re in bad shape.” And I said, “I’m okay.” But I wasn’t okay. But they were fantastic. And, frankly, very importantly, it’s something where we will never forget the people. We will not forget the people.

As part of our efforts, we're leveraging the unique capabilities of S&T's National Biodefense Analysis and Countermeasures Center to study the virus in a manner that is safe and secure. It's something that we've done, and done very well. We will continue to confront the virus with every resource at our disposal. We will never yield. We are always fighting. And we will win this battle.

When our nation was hit with the terrible pandemic, we produced not one, but two highly effective vaccines—and we did it in record time. We got them done, and we sent them out. We beat the world. And the vaccines have saved millions and millions of lives. We've done an incredible job. We are the envy of the world, if you want to know the truth.

You know, the President always says--the President always says we're at a turning-point moment as And that's exactly what it is. A turning point! We are putting America first, and we're going to continue putting America first. We are delivering for the American people, and everyone can see it. It's so easy to see it, and it's so good. It's really something.

Our military will soon be the strongest it has ever been. For more than 70 years, the United States has been the preeminent economic leader, and with that, it’s important that we always strengthen our military. We're making tremendous progress, much greater than the world ever thought possible. We're going to have the greatest military ever. Very, very importantly, we are restoring prosperity to our nation.

You know what happened on the West Side Highway. That young wise guy drove over and, uh, hit a number of people. And he was a -- I think he was a very terrible, terrible person. And we are going to be with those families and just, you know, the people who were hurt were great people, great people. And we’ll be helping them out. We’re helping them out!

Key among these efforts are breaking chains of transmission between people. These measures have been adopted by many companies, universities, and schools. It's a very important thing, and we want to take care of it. Now, it's very important. We want to protect the safety and the health of their employees. The guidelines we've issued by CDC are very strong. They are very powerful. They're great. Follow them folks. We'll be doing very well.

The United States has the best military by far, anywhere in the world. We have tremendous firepower. We have tremendous people. We have the greatest equipment. And we are also, because of the relationships I have, working very, very well with other countries. And we're making a lot of progress. I'm doing very well with China, by the way. And we're very, very close to a deal, many people say. A deal that is in the best interest of our country.

And I think the word "vocational" is a much better word than, in many cases, the word "college." You don't have to go to college. And you know, maybe some people go to college and they're doing okay, but many people go to college, and they have no idea what they're doing.

If we are successful in this effort, then we can start the border project of building the wall. And that's a very important border project. It's a project that will stop people from coming in. We have a lot of people coming in. We don't want them. We want them to come in legally. And we'll have a great, beautiful country. It's already great, but it'll be greater. And we're going to build it. And we're going to build it fast.

Throughout our history, the American people have always been the true source of American greatness. And it’s a fact that we’ve seen. We will never, ever back down from defending the values and principles that have made our country, and all its people, so special. We will always protect the First Amendment, the Second Amendment, and every other freedom. We will never give up.

If we weren't here for the states, you would have had a problem in this country. We're helping them. We're helping them a lot. And we're helping them with money. We're helping them with everything. And the Democrats have been trying to stop it. They've been trying to stop it. But we're going ahead. We're winning. We're doing very well.

We're also taking action to prevent addiction by addressing the problem of overprescribing. And our administration is working to cut the price of prescription drugs, reduce the cost of healthcare, and protect patients with pre-existing conditions. We will always protect patients with pre-existing conditions. You know that. It is very important to me. It is so important. It’s a big part of my heart.

The UK and the U. S., as you probably have been seeing and hearing, we're the closest of allies. They want to make a deal very badly. And they need a deal. They need the deal. They want the deal very badly. And we're very, very happy, we're working very hard on the deal. A lot of people are going to be very happy. I think it's going to be very good.

But that's different than test, because with a test you can always say, "Oh, we--we --we have a problem or we have a situation." But when you're taking the shot and you're going through a lot of things, you hope, and you pray, and you fight. And we will fight for the American people. And we will win. We will win. We will win, because we have to win.

And after that person -- namely, me -- won, and convincingly won at 306 to 223, immediately you saw the Democrats. They were so upset. They were so angry. They were so unhappy. It was incredible. The single greatest election victory in the history -- it's true, in the history -- of this country. And, frankly, everyone knows it.

For decades, China has taken advantage of the United States. Now we have changed that, and we are changing it rapidly. We've made incredible deals. And if you look at what's happened with the trade deals, with the tariffs, with everything, the numbers are just incredible. They're beyond belief. The best numbers we've ever had.

As the United Kingdom makes preparations to exit the European Union, I have made clear the United States is prepared to continue close cooperation to ensure a smooth transition. We have a comprehensive trade deal, it’s working very well. Very well. And in order to promote a strong and thriving transatlantic relationship based on mutual respect and shared values, we must continue to work together to uphold peace, prosperity, and freedom.

The first pillar of our framework generously offers a path to citizenship for 1.8 million Dreamers, those who were brought here as children. And hopefully the Democrats, they want to do it also. They’re going to hopefully do it. They are terrific people. They are really great people, and we want them to stay. With that in mind, we are also looking at a plan that would allow many other people who have been in our country for a long time to become citizens.

For similar reasons, the United States will provide no support in recognition to the International Criminal Court. We are not going to let foreign bureaucrats -- some of whom the U.S. is not even dealing with -- try and prosecute American citizens. We are going to take care of our own citizens. We're protecting our citizens. We're not going to let any foreign country take care of our citizens. Because that's what we're doing. And so we are going to be doing that.
